plugins.name: amnesia
plugins.description: Seamless context continuity across compaction. Captures a structured handoff before each compact event and re-injects it after, so the agent resumes without losing its working state.

plugins.name: caveman-plus
plugins.description: Talk like caveman. Cut ~75% tokens. Keep all technical accuracy. Default level: full-plus.

plugins.name: total-recall
plugins.description: Cross-session, cross-CLI memory for AI coding assistants. Mines transcripts from 8 supported CLI clients and surfaces operator identity, standing decisions, bans, goals, and past corrections via 23 MCP tools, 4 hooks, and 15 slash commands. The operator becomes the source of truth; the model stops re-asking what they already told it.
